## Natural history notes

A slender, fast-moving lizard characterized by its long tail, pointed snout, and six pale stripes running along a dark brown to black body. In Florida, it is found in open, sunny habitats with sandy soils, including scrub, sandhills, pine flatwoods, dunes, roadsides, and disturbed areas. It is active during the day and often seen darting quickly across bare ground or through low vegetation while foraging for insects and other small invertebrates.
